text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v2.4.0-beta -> 5% eu-central. Change window 22:00-01:00 UTC. Monitor p95, 5xx, kv-hit. Reply /deploy pin or /deploy abort.
maria: seeing p95 jump ~11% immediately, tailing on larger prompts. No 5xx yet.
kevin: grabbing logs; looks like a transient spike of kv miss + slow disk IO on subset of hosts.
olga: could be cache warming + a different kernel path. Recommend soft-pin to previous stable for region rather than global rollback.
phil: agree. Soft-pin eu-central to v2.3.9 for 20m and run targeted smoke tests. Avoid rollout stop unless errors increase.
deploy-bot: To execute: `/deploy pin v2.3.9 --region eu-central --duration 20m --note "soft-pin: kv warmup/disk IO"`. Proceed?
maria: go ahead. Also capture a trace bundle for affected hosts.
deploy-bot: Pin accepted. Traffic routed to v2.3.9 in eu-central. ETA ~15s.
maria: confirmed flip. p95 down to +2% within 3m. kv hit ratio sampled 62% -> 88%.
kevin: opening hotfix PR to revert disk-prefetch tweak: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/cd34ef
olga: smoke tests green. No 5xx increase. Leave pin for full 20m.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0509 created: canary p95 spike observed; soft-pin applied eu-central. Owner: kevin. Severity: low.
phil: note for release notes: "5% canary observed disk-prefetch-related kv warmup; soft-pin applied in eu-central; fix PR in flight." Link: https://release-notes.redwood.dev/v2.4.0-beta
maria: will recheck at +10m and +18m; if stable let pin expire and schedule next bump to 10% in tomorrow's warm window.
kevin: will follow up after PR lands.
phil: closing thread once pin auto-expires or restored. Reminder scheduled in 15m to re-evaluate.
